The STEM Atlas

Every concept worth knowing across the sciences and computing — atomised, checkable, and linked two ways: to the shelf that teaches it rigorously, and to the story that makes you want to. Each concept also carries a W — a Wikipedia lookup for what is this, roughly? It is a glossary, not a teacher: the shelf still does the teaching.
